svg.text: SCALE 1:20 · FOUR LEAVES · PATTERN A (LEFT PAIR) · PATTERN B (RIGHT PAIR)
1 · WHITE TEXTURED GLASS IN LEAD CAME
LAMINATED, OPAL OR REEDED — HIDES CLOTHES
3 · LED STRIP 2700 K, SET BACK, DIMMABLE
Wall length and door count to follow the dressing plan.
Glass: white and textured so clothes read as soft shadow
at most — sample opal, reeded and seeded side by side,
Lead came or brass-capped came; pattern A or B to choose.
Frames: blackened steel (no wood). Pulls: brass.
Lighting on its own switch and dimmer (see Lighting).
Door study: elevation, patterns, lit section
